messages.subject: Error with loading library
parts:
Hi all,

From what I understand, we'll need to install the packages needed for the app locally before deploying the app. I'm using the foreach package in my app and it can only be installed on Linux but I'm running Windows, so is there some way to get around this?

Thanks!

Cheers,
JinRou
